thread:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — I want to lock MVP scope for Console observability by EOD. Customers keep asking for cost clarity + trace hooks. Quick thoughts?
Sam Patel: +1. We should be careful to not over-index on per-token billing right away. Start with per-route and per-model aggregates. :thumbsup:
Ruth Gomez: Launch criteria idea: (1) dashboards covering latency/cost/error per-route, (2) end-to-end trace hook for sampled requests, (3) alerting on SLO burn rate. If any of those missing -> can't GA.
Oliver King: Heard from ACME that they want a drilldown from global cost -> customer -> route -> prompt id. We can approximate with sampling and request tags, but not exact tokens without instrumenting SDK.
Maya Chen: Good call. Proposal: MVP = 3 dashboards (Overview, Cost, Errors), tracing hooks with 1% sampling + full-span dump for failures, and a cost-breakdown panel using sampled token estimates. No per-user billing yet.
Sam Patel: Implementation note: we can emit telemetry as: 
```
obs.emit({route: '/v1/generate', model: 'redwood-13b', tokens: 124, sampled: true})
```
We'll add `sampled` flag to keep it cheap.
Ruth Gomez: For error analytics: we need automatic grouping (stack-like), and quick link to traces. If grouping is manual later we'll get noisy. Also need a SLO health metric (p99 latency + error rate).
Oliver King: Ops concern: adding sampling + span dumps could spike storage. Can we bound retention for full spans to 7 days for GA? Longer requires billing opt-in.
Maya Chen: Agreed. GA retention = 7d for full spans, aggregates retained 90d. Documented in Console -> Observability settings.
deploy-bot: observability-backend v0.3 deployed to staging at 2024-11-20T14:12:03Z
Sam Patel: UX ask: cost panel should let users toggle breakdown by model/route/customer id and export CSV. Small checkbox: "Estimate tokens from sample" with tooltip.
Ruth Gomez: Launch checklist (quick): 1) API emits sampled tokens + route tag, 2) dashboards wired to sample estimator, 3) trace hook docs + SDK snippet, 4) alerts and runbook stub, 5) retention policy in settings page.
Maya Chen: Owners: Sam (cost panels + sampling telemetry), Ruth (alerts + errors), Oliver (trace retention + infra). I'll draft the PRD and share. If no objections I'll move this into sprint planning.
Oliver King: No objections from infra. Need a follow-up to estimate storage costs for 1% sampling at scale. I'll get numbers by tomorrow.
Sam Patel: I'll mockup the dashboard panels and CSV export today.
Maya Chen: Cool — thanks. If anyone has strong objections to the 7d full-span retention, speak now or in PRD comments. Otherwise moving forward. :rocket:
